tasks.subject: Task 1: In-memory cache fields on the model
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add Target.BlockedByFetchedAt and Package.TargetsStable as json:"-" fields, with a test locking the never-serialized invariant.

**Files:** backend/internal/model/types.go, backend/internal/model/types_test.go (new)

**Acceptance Criteria:** Target.BlockedByFetchedAt time.Time json:"-"; Package.TargetsStable bool json:"-"; json.Marshal emits neither field; module builds and full suite green.

**Verify:** cd backend && go test ./internal/model/ -v && go test ./...

```json:metadata
{"files": ["backend/internal/model/types.go", "backend/internal/model/types_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "cd backend && go test ./internal/model/ -v && go test ./...", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Target.BlockedByFetchedAt time.Time json:\"-\"", "Package.TargetsStable bool json:\"-\"", "json.Marshal emits neither field", "module builds and full suite green"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: BuildStateTask — state-conditional preservation + TargetsStable
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Preservation conditional on unchanged target state (transition → wipe), and compute pkg.TargetsStable with conservative polarity.

**Files:** backend/internal/obs/tasks.go (BuildStateTask.Run), backend/internal/obs/tasks_test.go

**Acceptance Criteria:** unchanged → four enrichment fields carried; changed → wiped; TargetsStable true iff same target set with identical states; existing TestBuildStateTask passes.

**Verify:** cd backend && go test ./internal/obs/ -run TestBuildStateTask -v && go test ./...

```json:metadata
{"files": ["backend/internal/obs/tasks.go", "backend/internal/obs/tasks_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "cd backend && go test ./internal/obs/ -run TestBuildStateTask -v && go test ./...", "acceptanceCriteria": ["state unchanged preserves all four enrichment fields", "state changed wipes them", "TargetsStable true only for identical target set with identical states", "existing TestBuildStateTask passes"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: BuildReasonTask — skip populated targets
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Skip the per-target _reason fetch when BuildReason is already populated (cycle-cached; Task 2's wipe is the invalidation).

**Files:** backend/internal/obs/tasks.go (BuildReasonTask.Run), backend/internal/obs/tasks_test.go

**Acceptance Criteria:** populated BuildReason → no HTTP call for that target; empty BuildReason still fetches alongside cached sibling; existing BuildReason tests pass.

**Verify:** cd backend && go test ./internal/obs/ -run TestBuildReasonTask -v && go test ./...

```json:metadata
{"files": ["backend/internal/obs/tasks.go", "backend/internal/obs/tasks_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "cd backend && go test ./internal/obs/ -run TestBuildReasonTask -v && go test ./...", "acceptanceCriteria": ["populated BuildReason → no HTTP call for that target", "empty BuildReason still fetches alongside cached sibling", "existing BuildReason tests pass"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: BlockedReasonTask — populated + 5-minute freshness
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Fetch blocked reasons only when some blocked target has empty BlockedBy or stale BlockedByFetchedAt (> 5m const TTL); stamp on non-empty value receipt.

**Files:** backend/internal/obs/tasks.go (BlockedReasonTask.Run + blockedByTTL const), backend/internal/obs/tasks_test.go

**Acceptance Criteria:** fresh populated → no HTTP call; stale → refetch + re-stamp; empty BlockedBy still fetches; stamp only on non-empty; existing BlockedReason tests pass.

**Verify:** cd backend && go test ./internal/obs/ -run TestBlockedReasonTask -v && go test ./...

```json:metadata
{"files": ["backend/internal/obs/tasks.go", "backend/internal/obs/tasks_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "cd backend && go test ./internal/obs/ -run TestBlockedReasonTask -v && go test ./...", "acceptanceCriteria": ["fresh populated blocked targets → no HTTP call", "stale target → refetch + re-stamp", "empty BlockedBy still fetches", "stamp only on non-empty value", "existing BlockedReason tests pass"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: VersionTask + ContainerTagsTask — skip when stable
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Both tasks skip their fetch when their value is known and TargetsStable confirmed no target changed.

**Files:** backend/internal/obs/tasks.go (VersionTask.Run, ContainerTagsTask.Run), backend/internal/obs/tasks_test.go

**Acceptance Criteria:** VersionTask skips when Version known + stable, fetches otherwise; ContainerTagsTask skips when tags known + stable, fetches otherwise (release chain never sets flag → always fetches); existing Version/ContainerTags tests pass.

**Verify:** cd backend && go test ./internal/obs/ -run 'TestVersionTask|TestContainerTagsTask' -v && go test ./...

```json:metadata
{"files": ["backend/internal/obs/tasks.go", "backend/internal/obs/tasks_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "cd backend && go test ./internal/obs/ -run 'TestVersionTask|TestContainerTagsTask' -v && go test ./...", "acceptanceCriteria": ["VersionTask skips when version known + stable, fetches otherwise", "ContainerTagsTask skips when tags known + stable, fetches otherwise", "existing Version/ContainerTags tests pass"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```
